sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Sunil Kr. Singh, learned counsel for the applicants, and Sri Raj Bahadur Verma, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application has been filed to quash charge sheet dated 13.12.2022, summoning order dated 13.1.2023 as well as entire proceeding of Case No. 469 of 2023, case crime No.781 of 2022, u/s 323, 504, 498A IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Kotwali, District Deoria.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into a written compromise.
It has been requested that the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise.
4. Learned AGA states that the impugned proceeding cannot be quashed until the aforesaid compromise is verified.
5. In view of the above, the applicants are directed to file the original deed of compromise before the court below within a period of 15 days from today.

7. For a period of two and a half months or till verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
8. However, the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 528 BNSS to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise, if need arises.
9. With the aforesaid direction, the present application is disposed of.
